description: PSEO — Census data linking graduates to employment via LEHD wage records. Earnings percentiles at 1/5/10 years post-graduation by institution, degree, and CIP. Use for graduate earnings analysis. Coverage changes by release; Census V4.13.0 (2025Q4) lists 952 institutions and partners in 32 states plus D.C.
